# health-info

One household's self-hosted health records. Authored data only: no charts, no scores, no
device series. Version {{ app_version }}, registry version {{ registry_version }}.

## API

Base URL: {{ base_url }}

- `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request. Tokens are issued on the Tokens page.
- JSON only. No CORS. `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- Every success carries the envelope keys `contract_version`, `generated_at`,
  `registry_version` beside the payload.
- Collections page with `limit` (default 50, max 1000) and `offset`, and accept `start`/`end`
  (inclusive dates, default the last 30 days). Rows live under `items`.
- Errors: `{"error": {"code", "message", "details": [{"path", "message"}]}}`. Ids from another
  account are `404`, never `403`.
- The full contract is at `{{ base_url }}/openapi.json` and `{{ base_url }}/docs`.

## Reads

`person`, `environment`, `periods`, `goals`, `programs`, `conditions`, `injuries`,
`allergies`, `medications`, `labs`, `vaccinations`, `practitioners`, `appointments`,
`dose-events`, `measurements`, `symptoms`, `checkins`, `notes`, `memory`.

Derived: `expected-doses` (one row per due slot, each with the `scheduled_for` to post back),
`adherence` (`?medication_id&start&end`), `summary` (one compact bundle: person age, goals,
programme, environment, constraints with a per-domain `state`, availability, missing domains,
memory counts), `health`.

## Writes

Writable by token: memory, notes, periods, symptoms, injuries, conditions, measurements,
dose-events, appointments, check-ins, goals, programmes, environment.

UI-only: identity (`/person`), medication plan, allergies, labs, vaccinations, practitioners.

- `POST` returns `201` with `Location`; `PATCH` returns the full resource; `DELETE` is `204`.
- Clients never set `verification_status`; a client injury or condition lands `unconfirmed`
  until the owner confirms it. A client appointment lands `planned`.
- Memory: read it before writing. One claim per entry, the owner's wording, no diagnoses, no
  transcripts, no third-party data. A changed claim is a new entry with `corrects_id`, not an
  edit. `locked` entries are read-only.
- A repeated dose event with the same `medication_id` and `scheduled_for` returns the existing
  row with `200`, so a retry is safe.

## Vocabulary

Metric codes, enums and units are fixed in the server registry
(`registry_version {{ registry_version }}`). Metric aliases resolve on input; responses always
carry the canonical code. A reading outside the plausible range is stored with a `warnings`
list; outside the hard range it is rejected.

## Not this service

Device or series aggregation, reminders, interpretation, scores, streaks, food logging,
client accounts, an admin data API.
